Order
06.04.2026 (M. Zothankhuma, J) Ms. F Intaz, learned counsel for the appellant/applicant is granted two days time to comply with the order dated 28.07.2025 for taking steps for service of notice upon the respondent No. 2.
The matter pertains to conviction of the appellant/ applicant under Section 376(2)(n) IPC.

Page No.# 3/3 It is also noticed that the Office Note dated 19.08.2025 states that the TCR has also been sent by the learned Trial Court in connection with Criminal Appeal No. 8/2025, inasmuch as there were three convictions, out of which the appellant herein is one of the three convicts.
List the matters on 30.04.2026, along with Criminal Appeal No. 8/2025.
